motions.name: ramp_up
motions.prompt: A person walks forward up an inclined ramp with steady steps

motions.name: ramp_down
motions.prompt: A person walks carefully down an inclined ramp

motions.name: step_over
motions.prompt: A person approaches a low obstacle, lifts one foot over it, then steps the other foot over and continues forward

motions.name: crouch_stand
motions.prompt: A person stands still, slowly crouches down deeply, pauses, and stands back up

motions.name: crouch_walk
motions.prompt: A person lowers into a crouch and walks forward under a low overhead obstacle while keeping their head down

motions.name: crawl
motions.prompt: A person kneels down, places both hands on the ground, and crawls forward on hands and knees

motions.name: climb_high_platform
motions.prompt: A person places both hands on a high platform, pulls their body upward, brings one knee onto the platform, and climbs onto it

motions.name: two_hand_vault
motions.prompt: A person approaches a waist-high obstacle, plants both hands on top, vaults both legs over it, and lands on their feet on the other side
